apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: app
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: ghcr.io/octo-dev/deploy-stack:abc123
        - name: collector
          image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.110.0
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: app-tls
---
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: app
